api_base_url.description: Optional override for the Management API base URL (example: `https://api.pingone.com/v1`). If unset, derived from `region`.

client_id.description: The Client ID for the worker application. Can also be set with the `PINGONE_CLIENT_ID` environment variable.

client_secret.description: The Client Secret for the worker application. Can also be set with the `PINGONE_CLIENT_SECRET` environment variable.

environment_id.description: The Environment ID where the worker application is defined. Can also be set with the `PINGONE_ENVIRONMENT_ID` environment variable.

github_api_base_url.description: Optional override for the GitHub API base URL (default: `https://api.github.com`). Can also be set with the `GITHUB_API_BASE_URL` environment variable.

github_api_version.description: Optional override for the GitHub API version header (default: `2022-11-28`). Can also be set with the `GITHUB_API_VERSION` environment variable.

github_token.description: GitHub classic personal access token for enterprise team APIs. Can also be set with the `GITHUB_TOKEN` environment variable.

oauth_token_url.description: Optional override for the OAuth token URL (example: `https://auth.pingone.com/<env_id>/as/token`). If unset, derived from `region` + `environment_id`.

region.description: The PingOne region to use. Short codes: `NA`, `EU`, `AP`, `CA`, `AU`, `SG`. Long codes: `NorthAmerica`, `Europe`, `AsiaPacific`, `Australia-AsiaPacific`, `Canada`, `Singapore`. Can also be set with the `PINGONE_REGION` environment variable. Default: `NA`
